steps: PARENT-BINDING
Bind the accepted Batch 535-546 archive and console plus the unchanged completed historical signal receipt.
DECLARED-SCOPE
Preserve exact declared processing revision, digest, mode, deployment, data location, retention policy, language and fixed purpose; never select or verify a provider.
REVIEW-CATEGORIES
Require eight bounded categories of declared planning review, without reading documents or establishing legal, security or authenticated approval.
SCOPE-BOUND-DECLARATIONS
Bind each issued review declaration to its exact issued candidate scope; copies and declarations from other revisions fail closed.
BOUNDED-DOSSIERS
At most eight active dossiers per controller and eight review slots per dossier; planning tickets are memory-local and non-executable.
REVISION-INVALIDATION
Every candidate revision invalidates all declarations and planning tickets; revisions advance exactly once and preserve dossier identity.
REVOCATION
Replacing or revoking a declared review invalidates earlier tickets; the same declaration object cannot refresh validity.
SIMULATED-EXPIRY
Use bounded monotonic caller-supplied simulation ticks and inclusive expiry; do not claim a real-time clock or watchdog.
NO-AUTHORITY-INFERENCE
Complete declarations still leave independent evidence validation, approach selection, fresh consent, explicit execution approval and runtime review unresolved.
REFERENCE-BOUNDARY
Retain bounded opaque references only; discard releases owned review references but does not erase caller-held objects or verify source bytes.
STATIC-PRESENTATION
Add an accessible heading-labelled static panel with no provider selector, dossier entry, consent, media or execution controls.
VERIFICATION-ACCEPTANCE
Verify full 162-file frontend suite, two matching builds, object-ID payload integrity and lease-guarded publication before acceptance.
title: Scope-bound processing evidence dossiers and revocable planning tickets
